posts.title: How to Season a Skillet (and How Not To)
content: Thin coats. If you remember nothing else from this guide, remember thin coats.
A seasoning layer is polymerized oil, not a coating of oil. Wipe the pan until it looks like you removed everything, then bake it upside down at 230C for an hour. Repeat twice.
The sticky patches everyone complains about come from thick coats every single time.
